operations.outcome: Supports: the pi/8 fitted-phase clustering survives support-orbit collapse and prior reweighting; 4 of 18 orbits are structurally inviable within the fit budget.

evidence.paraphrase: 14 of 18 support orbits are viable (chi2 <= 20.28, 7 dof, 3 sigma); orbits 1, 3, 8, 12 are structurally inviable within budget with best chi2 between 3.8e3 and 4.9e3.

Orbit-collapsed best-branch phases all lie within 0.04 rad of pi/8 multiples (14/14 at Delta = 0.05 versus 0.25 expected under a uniform null); the result is robust across uniform-over-fits, orbit-collapsed, and chi2-weighted priors.

operations.outcome: Supports with refinement: the loop phase is multi-valued at fixed physics, and its realized fiber values equal the measured CKM unitarity-triangle angles — angle inheritance, not presentation selection or UV quantization.

evidence.paraphrase: 61 minima from all 14 fitted orbits land on one physical point (17 observables agree to better than 1e-4 sigma) yet realize 18 distinct folded loop phases — orbit 4 alone yields phi = 0.818 and phi = 1.566 at identical observables; fiber cluster cores equal the fitted CKM angles beta, gamma, alpha to sub-milliradian precision.
